subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps and availability

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated capacity sizing call — next steps and availability

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the call today — really appreciated the context on FinTech Co's planned feature rollout and the expected peak times. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary workload: customer-facing chat + scripted document summarization.
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~150 requests/minute (avg payload ~300 tokens).
- Peak concurrency target: up to 120 concurrent sessions during market open windows.
- Latency requirement: p95 <= 250ms for short-turn prompts, up to 800ms acceptable for long summaries.
- Data controls: traffic routed through VPC, audit logs retained for 12 months.

Next best step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) where Dylan (sales engineer) can walk through throughput/latency profiling and we'll map these requirements to a Dedicated pool recommendation. Suggested agenda:
  1) Reconfirm traffic shape and payload sizes
  2) Run through sample qps/concurrency calculations and expected token/sec
  3) Discuss network/storage constraints and KMS requirements
  4) Timeline & next steps for Dedicated onboarding

Would love to get a 60-minute slot on calendar this week or early next. My availability: Thu 12/10 9–11am PST, Fri 12/11 10am–2pm PST, Mon 12/14 11am–4pm PST. I've also included a Calendly link below if that makes scheduling easier.

Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/dedicated-sizing-60
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567890

I'll attach a short capacity estimate template and a network checklist that would help us run through the sizing exercise during the call. If you want to invite someone from your infra/ops team, please do — their presence will speed up the network/security discussion.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachments: capacity_estimate_template.xlsx, network_requirements.pdf

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and proposed agenda — that aligns with what I heard internally. We are definitely interested in the Dedicated option given our SLA needs.

Availability: Fri 12/11 11am–1pm PST works well for our team (I can carve out that window). I've cc'd our infra alias (infra@fintechco.com) — I'll ask them to join as well so we can cover network/KMS requirements.

A couple quick clarifying questions before the sizing call:

Looking forward to the call.
